title: A mutation-aware search of 375 cancer cell-line proteomes recovers 53 of 8,470 acquired-lysine observations: code and deposited data
description:
Analysis code and panel-level deposited data for a study of mutation-created ("acquired") lysines as a covalent target class.

Two tiers. panel_data/ holds one tidy CSV per figure panel plus a JSON ledger of every number that figure's caption and text quote, so any figure can be redrawn from this deposit alone. The analysis scripts regenerate that panel data from the public sources listed in external_inputs.json.

Checks travel with the code. verify.py confirms every number a script computes still appears in the manuscript; reverse_check.py looks for the dangerous direction, a number in the text that no script produces; build_release.py refuses to assemble the deposit if any input is undeclared.
